recommendation: Keep the audit commit as-is. Revisit only if a later final FHIR-I/OO decision changes general CodeableConcept.coding requirements or adds Observation-specific guidance.
issue_request: Published/Persuasive STU3 FHIR-I issue asking to clarify CodeableConcept.coding Requirements from ambiguous translations/alternate encodings wording to "Allows for alternative encodings within a code system, and translations to other code systems."
initial_application: The change was applied by git/SVN commit 8dccaebe4c5e3d09baba92746ee9962fce460caf, "GF#16976 - clarify requirements on codeableconcept", whose git-svn revision @14292 matches the Jira comment.
additional_context: CodeableConcept is active in source/fhir.ini, and source/datatypes/codeableconcept.xml line 840 has the approved wording. A 2017 Zulip thread explains the ambiguity behind the old wording. FHIR-57092 is a later Triaged Observation-specific clarification request and is not a final datatype-level reversal.
reconciliation: No source change was made because the current build-scope source already satisfies the issue.

related_jiras.note: Later Triaged/indeterminate Observation-specific issue references the same datatype wording but is not final and does not supersede FHIR-16976.
